column1: # Measured runtime of each database-backed test package, in seconds.
# Bin-packing hints for .github/scripts/db_test_groups.py, nothing more. The
# package list itself is always discovered from the source tree, so a package
# missing from this file still runs -- it is just placed as if it were average.
# Stale numbers cost balance, never coverage.
# Measured with `go test -race -p 1` against a PostgreSQL 18.4 container, on a
# developer machine rather than a GitHub runner. Absolute values will differ on
# CI; the ratios are what the split needs.
